whats_new:
Playing with friends is smoother:
• A race against a friend starts with 3-2-1 Go!, so nobody's clock runs early
• Your phone chimes when it's your turn
• Team Build is all about building together: no points or medals, just stars, like every build
• No name to type before a Team Build
• Clearer steps for friends joining your room
• A dot on the menu when a friend races your challenge or finishes the puzzle you passed them
• iPhone Duo: Bloppit now fills the whole open screen
• Smaller fixes
